retrieved_sources.title: Configuring Email and Slack Notifications
retrieved_sources.text:
### 

### Summary

This guide outlines how to configure email notifications for changes made to a workload's CI/CD settings.

Once configured, any updates to the **basic information**, **source repository**, **build**, **deploy**, or **test configurations** will trigger email notifications to the specified recipients.

These notifications apply to **all branches associated with the selected usage type** (e.g., RELEASE, INTEGRATION).

Recipients will be alerted whenever configuration changes occur within branches of the corresponding usage category.

### Configure email notification for project level config change

* Go to Project Config page
	+ **Scenario 1:** use URL to locate the Project Config config page  
	
		- https://app.example.com/reference/resource-218<projectName>&view=basicConfig
	+ **Scenario 2:** search project Name to land onto Project Config config page  
	
		- Navigate to PipelineHub <https://app.example.com/reference/resource-004>
		- Search for the project name in the PipelineHub search bar
		- Click on the Project Config Tab Left NavBar
* Click Edit button on top
* Enter comma-separated email addresses in **Config Notifications** Section
* Click Save button
* Any changes to basic info/ source repo/ build/ deploy/ test configuration will notify email recipients configured above.
* 

### Configure email notification for branch level config change and ci/cd pipelines

		- Search for the project name in the PipelineHub search bar
		- Click on the Branch Categories Tab Left NavBar
* Click Edit button on the bottom for **Release / Maintenance / Integration / Other** branch type
* Enter comma-separated email addresses inthe Notification popup
* Click Save button

*\* This email configuration will apply to all branches configured to a particular usage type (RELEASE, INTEGRATION, etc.)*

*\* Email recipients configured here will get notified when branches config of corresponding usage type (RELEASE, INTEGRATION, etc.) are updated*

retrieved_sources.title: How to consume PipelineHub REST Services (IdentityService)
retrieved_sources.text:
* + - Enter your Application Name of your choice, your application URL and Email .
		- Resource :   search for **PIPELINEHUB-PRODUCTION (or PIPELINEHUB-STAGE)** as the case may be.
		- Available scopes – select the corresponding scopes available.
* You will receive an email that includes a clientID, clientSecret and Scope.
* **Register your ClientID (in PipelineHub)** :
	+ Navigate to **MyProfile on the top right part of the FAB page**(<https://app.example.com/reference/resource-004>)  (under your SSO Username)
	+ Please navigate to your profile, click the Edit button beside the IdentityService ClientID column  and update the ClientID in the header section of your profile.Please copy the following script to your machine and make the changes according to the email
* Download  the script from <https://app.example.com/reference/resource-043>  (**NEW SCRIPT with CLIENT CREDENTIAL GRANT**) to your machine. You may use the logic for obtaining the token in any platform of your choice (e.g. java, python)

                      Script can be copied to your local machine and update as per following :

              // include the values as received in the email when you register the client

      clientId="<Client-id>"   

      clientSecret="<client-secret>"    

      scope="<scope>"   e.g. for stage/dev it is  BusinessAppTeamsPIPELINEHUB-STAGE and PROD it will be BusinessAppTeams/PipelineHub

do NOT modify rest of the script.

       **Please notice that the grant_type = "client_credentials".  If you have "password" earlier in your automation, please modify it** .

retrieved_sources.title: API to update branch properties for multiple branches for a PipelineHub project
retrieved_sources.text:
**This API is exposed as a convenience, it's intended for updating simple config (eg. fixing a typo). Using the API doesn't guarantee functionalities would work because it's not verified by our QA.**

**Updating project config via PipelineHub UI is the only way that guarantees the functionalities. Any breakage in functionalities from this API won't be supported by PipelineHub team.**

This API is intended as a one time use option for CloudNative type projects only.

All branch properties, etc. can be updated via an API, this API only updates one project at a time, but it can update as many branches as you want.  If you have multiple projects, you could write an automation to repeat the below via API for each project.

There are 2 steps involved: 

### Step 1. Get the existing branch properties for all branches

Call the GET API below to get the existing branch properties for all branches of a given project

jsAPI endpointGET - rest/getProjectStageConfigDetails/<projectName>/BRANCH_PROPERTIES/Example<https://api.example.com/reference/resource-851>
